question: How to Configure Multiple Outputs in a PLC Ladder Rung?
body_html:
PLC multiple outputs configuration is the way output coils are arranged so one input condition switches several devices correctly. A single rung can drive more than one coil.

MethodHow it works
Parallel outputsCoils side by side, all switch together
Series interlockedOne output depends on another
Sequenced outputsOutputs switch one after another
Marker bitOne internal bit reused on several rungs

Parallel coils suit two pumps started by one button.
